description: A plain rank-and-file chinese shield soldier in the supplied pixel art style. A round grey iron helmet with a small knob, grey lamellar armor with pale trim, cream sleeves, dark bracers, a red neck scarf, a red waist sash with a red front cloth, dark boots with a tan band. A small round wooden shield with an iron rim and an iron boss on the left arm and a short spear in the right hand
face: A stern face with a short grey beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the round grey helmet, dark hair under its rim, the red scarf, grey lamellar armor, the red sash, the round shield on his left arm, the spear at his right side. Nothing hangs on his back.
guard_action: the shield comes up in front of the body on the left arm, the spear is held ready at the right side, the left foot steps forward

actions.idle: Shield-and-spear guard, shield in front on the left arm, spear in the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with shield and spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.pb1: SHIELD BASH. The spear stays upright at the side. Frames 3-6 the shield is pulled in to the chest and he crouches; frame 7 one step forward; frame 8 the shield is rammed forward with the whole body; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pb2: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the upper body winds far to the right, shield turning with it; frames 7-8 the spear swings around level from the side to the front; frames 9-11 hold in front. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pa3: Overhand spear stab. Frames 1-5 the spear is lifted above the right shoulder; frame 8 it is driven down over the top of the shield; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.ps1: Steadfast defence. Frames 1-6 the shield is drawn square in front of the body, knees and hips sink, the spear stands upright at the side; frame 8 he locks the stance; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 pb1 → pb2 → pa3, 전법 ps1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 기본 병종. 밋밋한 클립(p)만 쓴다.
